brand.name: Lay-Hounds
brand.aesthetic_goal: Bright, trustworthy SaaS landing page. Share brand DNA (pink accent) with the simulator app (/app) but prioritize a light, high-converting marketing feel.

mono_accent.usage: Overlines, labels, and micro-copy to bridge the gap with the tactical simulator app.

spacing_and_layout.grid_pattern: Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris) for features. Asymmetric spans with gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards to soften the stark white, contrasting with the app's rounded-none. Buttons rounded-full or rounded-lg.

surface_strategies.header: Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200. Sticky top.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border (border-slate-200), subtle shadow-sm. Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-md border-pink-500/30 transition-all.
surface_strategies.footer: High-contrast dark mode. bg-slate-900 text-white py-24.

components: Navigation Links (Features, How it Works, Pricing, FAQ)
header.layout: Flex container, logo left, nav center (desktop), CTA right. Use Shadcn Sheet for mobile nav.

hero.layout: Grid 12-col. Left 7-col: Text content. Right 5-col: Dashboard Mockup or Hero Abstract image.

content.headline: Lay smarter. Recover faster.
content.subheadline: The premier Betfair greyhound lay-betting recovery simulator. Test your strategies safely, then go Live.

hero.style: Bright, white background. Primary CTA in solid Pink (#EC4899), Secondary CTA outline/ghost.

features.layout: Bento Grid (Mode A). 3 columns on desktop. gap-6.
features.style: Cards with icons. Icons in Pink. Use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react.

how_it_works.style: Use JetBrains Mono for the step numbers to hint at the app's tactical nature.

demo_embed.layout: Full-width container with a max-w-5xl constrained inner wrapper.
demo_embed.content: Image or Video placeholder showing the dashboard mockup.
demo_embed.style: Wrap the image in a browser-mockup window. Deep shadow (shadow-2xl) to make it pop off the white background.

pricing.style: Highlight the paid tier with a pink border and a 'Most Popular' badge. Trust logos (Stripe, PayPal) directly under the paid CTA.

footer.layout: Grid with Brand info on left, links on right.
footer.content: © 2026 Lay-Hounds, Durham, UK. Links: Terms, Privacy, Refund.
footer.style: Dark background (#0F172A). Text slate-400. Hover text white.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Buttons and cards should have slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase. Use Tailwind transition-all duration-300.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Fade-in up animations for sections as they enter viewport using framer-motion (initial: opacity 0, y: 20; whileInView: opacity 1, y: 0).

dashboard_mockup.description: Clean, high-end SaaS dashboard mockup on a solid background.
dashboard_mockup.usage: Hero section right column or Demo embed section.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract, dynamic 3D graphic showing data flow.
hero_abstract.usage: Alternative hero graphic or background texture.

greyhound_image.usage: About/Contact section background or subtle texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind for marketing page structures. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions like Accordion (FAQ).
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and major sections.
Ensure the hero section uses the generated dashboard mockup.
Do not alter the /app route or simulator styling, apply these changes ONLY to the marketing pages (/).
